network.cause: The fixture accepts from a nonblocking listener, then uses blocking read_exact and duplex handlers without explicitly selecting blocking mode for accepted sockets. Socket-mode inheritance differs across operating systems. Forcing nonblocking accepted sockets on Linux reproduces both the hosted SOCKS request error and exact CONNECT UnexpectedEof.
